name: Proxmox VE
description: Reads your Proxmox VMs and containers so the map and device pages show which devices run on which Proxmox host. Read-only.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Adds the power actions (hard reset, restart, shut down, start) that Netlens 0.4.50 can use for auto-remediation: a rule can restart a frozen guest. Nothing else changed; older Netlens versions ignore the new function.
Now an ordinary plugin (it was built into Netlens before 0.4.44). Same code as the built-in version 1.4.0; Netlens installs it again by itself for existing setups.
